chapter: Europe and the Black and Blue years
title: A writer's family in France; first trips in 1962, 1973 and 1975
summary: She mentions another French family headed by a writer, met at George Wein's 1975 festival. She dates her first French trip to 1973 for Black and Blue, after the 1962 blues festival.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe

Yeah, and he was so nice, he and his family. And I hear from them all the time.
Oh, do you? When did you first meet them?
When I went over to the Festival.
Oh, was that in the sixties?
That was now. That was in '75.
Oh. Did you go over for George? (Wein)
Yes, let me see, '75. But the first time I went to France was in '73.
Well you went to France first of all in '62.
Yeah, that was different. The Black and Blue records.
Yeah, I wanted to talk to you about that too. That was in '73?
